segments.text: Next tool, metal fab laser, welder, 1200 watt unboxing and first use.
segments.zh: xTool MetalFab 激光焊机 1200 瓦，开箱与首次使用。

segments.text: Take out all the items.
segments.zh: 取出所有物品。

segments.text: Pay attention to the unboxing tips.
segments.zh: 注意开箱提示。

segments.text: Open the lid first.
segments.zh: 先打开顶盖。

segments.text: Pull apart from the side to open and remove the enclosure.
segments.zh: 从侧面拉开，打开并取下外箱。

segments.text: Take out the welding head first, then remove the foam.
segments.zh: 先取出焊接头，再取出泡沫。

segments.text: Wind the cable on the side of the main unit, and place the welding head on the bracket.
segments.zh: 把线缆缠绕在主机侧面，并把焊接头放在支架上。

segments.text: Place the main unit.
segments.zh: 放置主机。

segments.text: Leave a gap of more than 10 centimeters at the front and back of the main unit.
segments.zh: 主机前后要留出 10 厘米以上的间隙。

segments.text: Lock the four caster wheels.
segments.zh: 锁住四个脚轮。

segments.text: Connect the shielding gas cylinder.
segments.zh: 连接保护气气瓶。

segments.text: Insert one end of the tube into the shielding gas inlet on the main unit.
segments.zh: 把气管的一端插入主机上的保护气进气口。

segments.text: Connect the other end of the tube to the cylinder, or gas generator.
segments.zh: 把气管的另一端连接到气瓶或气体发生器上。

segments.text: Place the welding head.
segments.zh: 放置焊接头。

segments.text: Assemble the welding head cradle.
segments.zh: 组装焊接头托架。

segments.text: Place the welding head on the cradle.
segments.zh: 把焊接头放在托架上。

segments.text: Connect the workpiece sensing cable.
segments.zh: 连接工件感应线。

segments.text: Insert the connector end into the port for the workpiece sensing cable.
segments.zh: 把接头一端插入工件感应线的接口。

segments.text: Connect to a power supply.
segments.zh: 连接电源。

segments.text: This product requires a 220 to 240 volt AC power supply, and works at a rated power of
segments.zh: 本产品需要 220 至 240 伏交流电源，额定功率为

segments.text: 4.2 kilowatts and a full load current of 21 amperes.
segments.zh: 4.2 千瓦，满载电流为 21 安培。

segments.text: An individual branch circuit with a current carrying capacity of 25 amperes or above is
segments.zh: 建议使用载流能力在 25 安培及以上的独立分支电路

segments.text: recommended.
segments.zh: 供电。

segments.text: Ensure that the power supply is grounded.
segments.zh: 确保电源已接地。

segments.text: The connection of power cables varies with their standards.
segments.zh: 电源线的接法因其标准不同而有所差异。

segments.text: If hard wiring operation is required, it should be performed by a professional electrician.
segments.zh: 如果需要硬接线操作，应由专业电工来完成。

segments.text: Attach the round connector of the power cable to the main unit.
segments.zh: 把电源线的圆形接头连接到主机上。

segments.text: The larger pin faces upward.
segments.zh: 较粗的插针朝上。

segments.text: Check the emergency stop button.
segments.zh: 检查急停按钮。

segments.text: Ensure that the emergency stop button is released.
segments.zh: 确保急停按钮处于松开状态。

segments.text: Insert the key.
segments.zh: 插入钥匙。

segments.text: Insert the key into its designated port.
segments.zh: 把钥匙插入指定的钥匙孔。

segments.text: Power on and unlock the device.
segments.zh: 开机并解锁设备。

segments.text: On the back panel of the main unit, turn on the power switch to activate the device.
segments.zh: 在主机后面板上，打开电源开关以启动设备。

segments.text: On the touchscreen, select a language and unit.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上选择语言和单位。

segments.text: The first time you turn on the device, you will see a QR code on the touchscreen.
segments.zh: 第一次开机时，你会在触摸屏上看到一个二维码。

segments.text: Scan the QR code to watch the safety training videos.
segments.zh: 扫描二维码观看安全培训视频。

segments.text: After watching the video, input the serial number shown on the touchscreen to the web.
segments.zh: 看完视频后，把触摸屏上显示的序列号输入到网页中，

segments.text: To generate an unlock password for your device.
segments.zh: 为你的设备生成解锁密码。

segments.text: On the touchscreen of your device, tap enter the password.
segments.zh: 在设备的触摸屏上，点击“输入密码”。

segments.text: Enter the password generated to unlock your device.
segments.zh: 输入生成的密码来解锁设备。

segments.text: Calibrate the focus for the welding head.
segments.zh: 校准焊接头的焦点。

segments.text: On the home page of the touchscreen, tap system settings and check the value of focus
segments.zh: 在触摸屏主页上，点击“系统设置”，查看焦点

segments.text: scale reference.
segments.zh: 刻度参考值。

segments.text: Check if the graduated tube is of the same value.
segments.zh: 检查刻度管是否为相同的数值。

segments.text: If yes, no calibration is needed.
segments.zh: 如果是，就不需要校准。

segments.text: If not, adjust the graduated tube.
segments.zh: 如果不是，就调整刻度管。

segments.text: Open the fastener.
segments.zh: 打开卡扣。

segments.text: Push or pull the graduated tube to adjust it to the reference value.
segments.zh: 推动或拉动刻度管，把它调到参考值。

segments.text: Connect the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 连接送丝机。

segments.text: The wire feeder is used to feed wire in laser welding, and it is not needed in metal
segments.zh: 送丝机用于激光焊接时送丝，在金属

segments.text: cleaning or cutting.
segments.zh: 清洗或切割时不需要。

segments.text: Place the wire feeder on the left side of the main unit.
segments.zh: 把送丝机放在主机的左侧。

segments.text: Lock the four caster wheels.
segments.zh: 锁住四个脚轮。

segments.text: Connect to the main unit.
segments.zh: 连接到主机。

segments.text: Use the wire feeder cable to connect them.
segments.zh: 用送丝机线缆把它们连接起来。

segments.text: The small protrusion on the inner wall faces upwards.
segments.zh: 内壁上的小凸起朝上。

segments.text: Insert the connector.
segments.zh: 插入接头。

segments.text: Screw the metal part.
segments.zh: 拧紧金属部分。

segments.text: Install the drive rolls.
segments.zh: 安装送丝轮。

segments.text: This video exemplifies installing 1mm welding wire on the 1mm guiding rail.
segments.zh: 本视频以在 1mm 导轨上安装 1mm 焊丝为例。

segments.text: Open the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 打开送丝机。

segments.text: Open the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 打开送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Remove the screws.
segments.zh: 拆下螺丝。

segments.text: Install the drive rolls.
segments.zh: 安装送丝轮。

segments.text: Install the screws back.
segments.zh: 把螺丝装回去。

segments.text: Store the other pair of drive rolls above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把另一对送丝轮存放在送丝驱动器上方。

segments.text: Install the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 安装送丝管。

segments.text: Close the right tensioner.
segments.zh: 合上右侧的压紧器。

segments.text: Loosen the screw on the right side of the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 松开送丝驱动器右侧的螺丝。

segments.text: Insert the end of the wire feeding tube without a fastener to the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 把送丝管没有卡扣的一端插入送丝机。

segments.text: Slide the nozzle in until its stem presses against the right panel of the wire feeding
segments.zh: 把喷嘴滑进去，直到它的杆部抵住送丝

segments.text: driver.
segments.zh: 驱动器的右侧面板。

segments.text: Tighten the screw to fix the nozzle.
segments.zh: 拧紧螺丝以固定喷嘴。

segments.text: Open the right tensioner.
segments.zh: 打开右侧的压紧器。

segments.text: Load the welding wire.
segments.zh: 装上焊丝。

segments.text: Unscrew the cap and remove the sleeve.
segments.zh: 拧下盖子，取下套筒。

segments.text: Align the hole with the pin.
segments.zh: 把孔对准销钉。

segments.text: Ensure that the wire spool is installed in the correct direction.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝盘的安装方向正确。

segments.text: After released, the wire comes out from the bottom of the wire spool to enter the wire
segments.zh: 放线后，焊丝从焊丝盘的底部出来，进入送丝

segments.text: feeding driver.
segments.zh: 驱动器。

segments.text: Install the sleeve and the cap back.
segments.zh: 把套筒和盖子装回去。

segments.text: Take out the wire end.
segments.zh: 取出焊丝末端。

segments.text: Do not release the wire or it will unravel.
segments.zh: 不要松开焊丝，否则它会散开。

segments.text: Cut off the bent end of the wire.
segments.zh: 剪掉焊丝弯曲的末端。

segments.text: Thread the wire into the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把焊丝穿入送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Press the wire slightly to make it pass through.
segments.zh: 轻轻按压焊丝，让它穿过去。

segments.text: Ensure that the wire passes through the drive rolls into the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝穿过送丝轮进入送丝管。

segments.text: Close the tensioners.
segments.zh: 合上压紧器。

segments.text: Rotate the tensioner's knobs to adjust the wire feed tension.
segments.zh: 转动压紧器的旋钮来调节送丝张力。

segments.text: Feed the welding wire.
segments.zh: 送出焊丝。

segments.text: When delivered, the wire feeding tube is installed with a 0.8 slash 1.0 nozzle at the end with
segments.zh: 出厂时，送丝管带卡扣的一端已经装好了 0.8/1.0 的喷嘴，

segments.text: a fastener.
segments.zh: 就在这一端。

segments.text: Press and hold the feed button on the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 按住送丝机上的送丝按钮。

segments.text: The wire spool rotates counterclockwise at a constant speed.
segments.zh: 焊丝盘以恒定速度逆时针转动。

segments.text: When the wire extends from the nozzle, stop wire feeding.
segments.zh: 当焊丝从喷嘴伸出来时，停止送丝。

segments.text: If the wire extends too far, press the retract button to return the wire.
segments.zh: 如果焊丝伸出太多，按回抽按钮把焊丝退回去。

segments.text: Close the door of the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 关上送丝机的门。

segments.text: Install the wire feeding tube on the welding head.
segments.zh: 把送丝管安装到焊接头上。

segments.text: Open the fastener.
segments.zh: 打开卡扣。

segments.text: Slide it onto the welding head tip.
segments.zh: 把它滑到焊接头的端部。

segments.text: Ensure that the wire comes out from the groove of the welding nozzle.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝从焊接喷嘴的槽中出来。

segments.text: Close the fastener.
segments.zh: 扣上卡扣。

segments.text: Fine tune the wire.
segments.zh: 微调焊丝。

segments.text: Secure the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 固定好送丝管。

segments.text: Place back on the welding head cradle.
segments.zh: 放回焊接头托架上。

segments.text: Use X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder 1200 watts.
segments.zh: 使用 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机 1200 瓦。

segments.text: Before operating the device, please follow the safety instructions to put on PPE and
segments.zh: 在操作设备之前，请按照安全说明穿戴个人防护装备，并

segments.text: take proper safety precautions.
segments.zh: 采取适当的安全防范措施。

segments.text: Necessary PPE includes laser safety goggles, welding helmets, dust mask, laser and heat
segments.zh: 必要的个人防护装备包括激光防护眼镜、焊接面罩、防尘口罩、防激光和耐热的

segments.text: resistant gloves, clothing and aprons.
segments.zh: 手套、服装以及围裙。

segments.text: Ensure that the workroom is well ventilated.
segments.zh: 确保工作间通风良好。

segments.text: Laser welding in standard mode.
segments.zh: 标准模式下的激光焊接。

segments.text: Ensure that a gas flow meter is fitted to the gas cylinder or gas generator.
segments.zh: 确保气瓶或气体发生器上装有气体流量计。

segments.text: Ensure that enable lasering is off.
segments.zh: 确保“启用激光”处于关闭状态。

segments.text: Open the gas cylinder valve.
segments.zh: 打开气瓶阀门。

segments.text: Press and hold the grip sensing button and trigger to allow gas flow.
segments.zh: 按住握持感应按钮和扳机，让气体流出。

segments.text: Meanwhile, adjust the gas flow rate to 15 to 30 liters per minute.
segments.zh: 同时，把气体流量调到每分钟 15 到 30 升。

segments.text: Press the workpiece on a metal base.
segments.zh: 把工件压在金属底座上。

segments.text: Clamp the workpiece sensing cable to the workpiece or to a conductive object connected with the
segments.zh: 把工件感应线夹在工件上，或者夹在与

segments.text: workpiece.
segments.zh: 工件相连的导电物体上。

segments.text: It is strictly prohibited to attach the clamp to the graduated tube of the welding head.
segments.zh: 严禁把夹子夹在焊接头的刻度管上。

segments.text: Press the feed and retract buttons on the welding head to adjust the wire until its
segments.zh: 按焊接头上的送丝和回抽按钮调整焊丝，直到它的

segments.text: tip coincides with the red spot.
segments.zh: 末端与红点重合。

segments.text: Calibrate the welding head if the red spot falls at the left or right side of the
segments.zh: 如果红点落在伸出焊丝的左侧或右侧，

segments.text: extended wire or if the spot is not visible or blurred.
segments.zh: 或者红点看不见或模糊，就需要校准焊接头。

segments.text: Refer to the calibrate the red spot position part in maintenance.
segments.zh: 请参阅维护部分中的“校准红点位置”。

segments.text: Turn on the wire feeding enable switch to enable the auto feeding function.
segments.zh: 打开送丝使能开关，启用自动送丝功能。

segments.text: On the touch screen, choose standard mode, weld.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上选择标准模式，焊接。

segments.text: Select the material type, material thickness and wire diameter.
segments.zh: 选择材料类型、材料厚度和焊丝直径。

segments.text: Tap enable wire feeding to allow wire feeding.
segments.zh: 点击“启用送丝”以允许送丝。

segments.text: And tap enable lasering to allow laser emission.
segments.zh: 再点击“启用激光”以允许激光出光。

segments.text: Align the parts to be welded.
segments.zh: 把待焊接的零件对齐。

segments.text: Aiming the welding nozzle at the starting point, press and hold the grip sensing button
segments.zh: 把焊接喷嘴对准起点，按住握持感应按钮

segments.text: and trigger to start welding.
segments.zh: 和扳机开始焊接。

segments.text: Tack weld the starting and ending points first, then start seam welding.
segments.zh: 先点焊起点和终点，然后开始焊缝焊接。

segments.text: As the welding head feeds the wire forward, a reaction force is generated from the welding
segments.zh: 焊接头向前送丝时，焊接点会产生一个反作用力，

segments.text: point that pushes the welding head backward.
segments.zh: 把焊接头往后推。

segments.text: Simply hold the welding head steady and guide the direction.
segments.zh: 只需稳稳握住焊接头并引导方向即可。

segments.text: To avoid wire sticking, do not press the welding head downward.
segments.zh: 为避免粘丝，不要往下压焊接头。

segments.text: After the welding is completed, the workpiece and parts of the welding head will remain
segments.zh: 焊接完成后，工件和焊接头的部分部位仍然会很

segments.text: hot.
segments.zh: 烫。

segments.text: Do not touch the hot areas without protection.
segments.zh: 没有防护时不要触摸高温区域。

segments.text: Turn off enable wire feeding and enable lasering.
segments.zh: 关闭“启用送丝”和“启用激光”。

segments.text: Laser cleaning.
segments.zh: 激光清洗。

segments.text: Turn off the device.
segments.zh: 关闭设备。

segments.text: Remove the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 取下送丝管。

segments.text: Remove the welding nozzle.
segments.zh: 取下焊接喷嘴。

segments.text: Replace with the cleaning nozzle.
segments.zh: 换上清洗喷嘴。

segments.text: Turn on the device.
segments.zh: 打开设备。

segments.text: Tap clean.
segments.zh: 点击“清洗”。

segments.text: Tap enable lasering.
segments.zh: 点击“启用激光”。

segments.text: Tap confirm.
segments.zh: 点击“确认”。

segments.text: Aim the cleaning nozzle at the starting point with the welding head parallel to the
segments.zh: 把清洗喷嘴对准起点，焊接头与

segments.text: weld seam.
segments.zh: 焊缝平行。

segments.text: Press and hold the grip sensing button and trigger to start laser cleaning.
segments.zh: 按住握持感应按钮和扳机开始激光清洗。

segments.text: Laser cleaning is completed.
segments.zh: 激光清洗完成。

segments.text: Laser cutting.
segments.zh: 激光切割。

segments.text: On the touch screen, tap system settings and take down the value of focus scale reference.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上点击“系统设置”，记下焦点刻度参考值。

segments.text: Turn off the device.
segments.zh: 关闭设备。

segments.text: Open the fastener to remove the current tip.
segments.zh: 打开卡扣，取下当前的喷嘴头。

segments.text: Insert the cutting tip.
segments.zh: 插入切割头。

segments.text: Keep consistent with focus scale reference.
segments.zh: 与焦点刻度参考值保持一致。

segments.text: Close the fastener.
segments.zh: 扣上卡扣。

segments.text: Place the gas flow meter on the cylinder with a gas pressure reducing valve.
segments.zh: 把气体流量计装在带减压阀的气瓶上。

segments.text: Turn on the device and check if the welding head emits a clear and integral red spot.
segments.zh: 打开设备，检查焊接头是否发出清晰完整的红点。

segments.text: If not, calibrate the red spot position to avoid burning the nozzle during laser cutting.
segments.zh: 如果没有，就校准红点位置，以免激光切割时烧坏喷嘴。

segments.text: Adjust the air pressure to 0.8 to 1.2 MPa.
segments.zh: 把气压调到 0.8 到 1.2 MPa。

segments.text: Tap cut.
segments.zh: 点击“切割”。

segments.text: Select the material type and material thickness.
segments.zh: 选择材料类型和材料厚度。

segments.text: Tap enable lasering.
segments.zh: 点击“启用激光”。

segments.text: Tap confirm.
segments.zh: 点击“确认”。

segments.text: Start laser cutting.
segments.zh: 开始激光切割。

segments.text: Laser cutting is completed.
segments.zh: 激光切割完成。

segments.text: Replace the wire feeding nozzle.
segments.zh: 更换送丝喷嘴。

segments.text: The wire feeding tube has an end with a fastener and a replaceable nozzle.
segments.zh: 送丝管有一端带卡扣和可更换的喷嘴。

segments.text: You need to replace the nozzle based on the diameter of the welding wire.
segments.zh: 你需要根据焊丝直径来更换喷嘴。

segments.text: Next tool, MetalFab CNC cutter.
segments.zh: xTool MetalFab 数控切割机。

segments.text: Unboxing and first use.
segments.zh: 开箱与首次使用。

segments.text: Unbox the package following the instructions on it.
segments.zh: 按照包装上的说明进行开箱。

segments.text: Leave a clearance of at least 1 meter around the package before unboxing.
segments.zh: 开箱前，在包装周围至少留出 1 米的空间。

segments.text: First, release the seven latches on the front panel.
segments.zh: 首先，松开前面板上的七个锁扣。

segments.text: Lay down the panel as a ram.
segments.zh: 把这块面板放倒当作坡道。

segments.text: Then release the three latches on the left panel.
segments.zh: 然后松开左面板上的三个锁扣。

segments.text: Release the three latches on the right panel.
segments.zh: 松开右面板上的三个锁扣。

segments.text: And release the three latches on the rear panel.
segments.zh: 再松开后面板上的三个锁扣。

segments.text: At last, remove all the other panels except the bottom one.
segments.zh: 最后，拆掉除底板以外的所有其他面板。

segments.text: Tear open the black strap securing the main unit.
segments.zh: 撕开固定主机的黑色捆扎带。

segments.text: Remove the plastic bag.
segments.zh: 取下塑料袋。

segments.text: Lift the four leveling feet.
segments.zh: 升起四个调平脚。

segments.text: Use the wrench to loosen the top nuts clockwise.
segments.zh: 用扳手顺时针拧松上螺母。

segments.text: Manually turn the top nuts until they touch the lower nuts.
segments.zh: 用手转动上螺母，直到它们碰到下螺母。

segments.text: Use the wrench to loosen the lower nuts counterclockwise.
segments.zh: 用扳手逆时针拧松下螺母。

segments.text: Manually turn the leveling feet counterclockwise to lift them.
segments.zh: 用手逆时针转动调平脚把它们升起来。

segments.text: The leveling feet should be about 1 centimeter above the limit blocks.
segments.zh: 调平脚应高出限位块约 1 厘米。

segments.text: Move the machine down the ramp.
segments.zh: 把机器沿坡道移下来。

segments.text: Move the machine to the desired position.
segments.zh: 把机器移到想要的位置。

segments.text: Leave at least 50 centimeters around the machine for assembly.
segments.zh: 机器周围至少留出 50 厘米的空间用于组装。

segments.text: Lower the leveling feet to secure the machine.
segments.zh: 放下调平脚以固定机器。

segments.text: Manually turn the leveling feet clockwise to lower them until they touch the ground.
segments.zh: 用手顺时针转动调平脚把它们放下，直到接触地面。

segments.text: Use the wrench to tighten the lower nuts clockwise.
segments.zh: 用扳手顺时针拧紧下螺母。

segments.text: Manually turn the top nuts counterclockwise until they touch the main unit base plate.
segments.zh: 用手逆时针转动上螺母，直到它们碰到主机底板。

segments.text: Then use the wrench to secure them.
segments.zh: 然后用扳手把它们固定好。

segments.text: Lift the main unit.
segments.zh: 抬升主机。

segments.text: Remove the four fixing bars at the bottom corners.
segments.zh: 拆下底部四个角上的四根固定杆。

segments.text: Use the hex key to loosen the screws.
segments.zh: 用内六角扳手拧松螺丝。

segments.text: Remove four fixing bars.
segments.zh: 拆下四根固定杆。

segments.text: Lift the main unit following the instruction.
segments.zh: 按照说明抬升主机。

segments.text: At the back of the main unit, use the Z-shaped wrench to lift the main unit.
segments.zh: 在主机后部，用 Z 形扳手抬升主机。

segments.text: Meanwhile, pay attention to the white lines on the side.
segments.zh: 同时，注意侧面的白线。

segments.text: Get at eye level with the base beam to observe the white line.
segments.zh: 视线与底梁齐平，观察白线。

segments.text: When the white line is level with the base beam, stop lifting the main unit.
segments.zh: 当白线与底梁齐平时，停止抬升主机。

segments.text: Install four long fixing bars.
segments.zh: 安装四根长固定杆。

segments.text: Align the holes on the long fixing bar to those of the main unit.
segments.zh: 把长固定杆上的孔与主机上的孔对齐。

segments.text: Screw in four screws to secure the bar.
segments.zh: 拧入四颗螺丝固定这根杆。

segments.text: Install the other three bars in the same way.
segments.zh: 用同样的方法安装另外三根杆。

segments.text: Then use the hex key to fully tighten all the screws on the four bars.
segments.zh: 然后用内六角扳手把四根杆上的所有螺丝完全拧紧。

segments.text: Install four short fixing bars.
segments.zh: 安装四根短固定杆。

segments.text: The four bars shall be attached to the front, left, and right sides of the machine.
segments.zh: 这四根杆应安装在机器的前侧、左侧和右侧。

segments.text: Mind the installation direction of the bars.
segments.zh: 注意杆的安装方向。

segments.text: Align the holes and secure the bars with screws.
segments.zh: 对准孔位，用螺丝固定这些杆。

segments.text: Install the side plates.
segments.zh: 安装侧板。

segments.text: Align the grooves in the side plate with the protrusions on the main unit.
segments.zh: 把侧板上的凹槽对准主机上的凸起。

segments.text: Push the side plate towards the main unit.
segments.zh: 把侧板朝主机推进去。

segments.text: Secure the side plate with two screws.
segments.zh: 用两颗螺丝固定侧板。

segments.text: Install the front plate.
segments.zh: 安装前板。

segments.text: Align the protrusions on the front plate with the grooves in the main unit.
segments.zh: 把前板上的凸起对准主机上的凹槽。

segments.text: Push the front plate towards the main unit.
segments.zh: 把前板朝主机推进去。

segments.text: Secure the front plate with four screws.
segments.zh: 用四颗螺丝固定前板。

segments.text: The front plate is installed.
segments.zh: 前板安装完成。

segments.text: Install the back plate.
segments.zh: 安装后板。

segments.text: Align the grooves in the back plate with the protrusions on the main unit.
segments.zh: 把后板上的凹槽对准主机上的凸起。

segments.text: Push the back plate towards the main unit.
segments.zh: 把后板朝主机推进去。

segments.text: Secure the back plate with five screws.
segments.zh: 用五颗螺丝固定后板。

segments.text: The back plate is installed.
segments.zh: 后板安装完成。

segments.text: Install the base plate.
segments.zh: 安装底盘。

segments.text: Align the base plate with the slots and push it in.
segments.zh: 把底盘对准插槽并推进去。

segments.text: To prevent the base plate from deformation due to prolonged processing,
segments.zh: 为防止底盘因长时间加工而变形，

segments.text: please add an appropriate amount of sand or water into the base plate for heat insulation.
segments.zh: 请在底盘中加入适量的沙子或水用于隔热。

segments.text: Install the exhaust fan. Ensure that the side with arrows is facing up.
segments.zh: 安装排风扇。确保带箭头的一面朝上。

segments.text: Attach the connector of the exhaust fan to that of the main unit.
segments.zh: 把排风扇的接头与主机的接头连接起来。

segments.text: Tuck the excess connecting wire into the hole of the exhaust fan.
segments.zh: 把多余的连接线塞进排风扇的孔里。

segments.text: Align to the four pins on the main unit and install the fan.
segments.zh: 对准主机上的四个定位销，安装风扇。

segments.text: Gently press the fan down to make it fully seated.
segments.zh: 轻轻往下按风扇，使其完全就位。

segments.text: Slide the clamp onto the pipe. Fit to the fan.
segments.zh: 把卡箍套到管子上。装到风扇上。

segments.text: Tighten the pipe clamp clockwise to secure the smoke exhaust pipe.
segments.zh: 顺时针拧紧管卡箍，固定排烟管。

segments.text: Slide the pipe clamp onto the exhaust pipe.
segments.zh: 把管卡箍套到排气管上。

segments.text: Insert the pipe connector to the pipe.
segments.zh: 把管接头插入管子。

segments.text: Tighten the pipe clamp clockwise to secure the connection.
segments.zh: 顺时针拧紧管卡箍，固定连接处。

segments.text: Snap the pipe connector to the corresponding port of X-Tool Safety Pro AP2 Max.
segments.zh: 把管接头卡入 xTool Safety Pro AP2 Max 的对应接口。

segments.text: For more information on how to use AP2 Max, refer to its quick start guide and safety instructions.
segments.zh: 关于如何使用 AP2 Max 的更多信息，请参阅其快速入门指南和安全说明。

segments.text: Install other accessories. Align the external antenna with the hole at the back of the main unit.
segments.zh: 安装其他配件。把外置天线对准主机背面的孔。

segments.text: Tighten the antenna clockwise. Lift the antenna upwards. Align the holes of the hook with those
segments.zh: 顺时针拧紧天线。把天线向上竖起。把挂钩上的孔对准

segments.text: of the machine. Secure the hook with screws. Install the welding head. Insert one end of
segments.zh: 机器上的孔。用螺丝固定挂钩。安装焊接头。把

segments.text: the communication cable to the EX-Control port at the back of the machine. Then rotate the
segments.zh: 通信线的一端插入机器背面的 EX-Control 接口。然后顺时针转动

segments.text: connector clockwise to tighten it. Insert the other end to the X-Control port of X-Tool Metal
segments.zh: 接头将其拧紧。把另一端插入 xTool MetalFab

segments.text: Fab Laser Welder. Then rotate the connector clockwise to tighten it. Open the protective
segments.zh: 激光焊机的 X-Control 接口。然后顺时针转动接头将其拧紧。打开机器的

segments.text: lid of the machine. Three wing bolts are pre-installed in the machine. Please take
segments.zh: 防护盖。机器内预装了三颗蝶形螺栓。请在

segments.text: them out before use. Loosen the bolts counterclockwise and take out the bolts in the tabs.
segments.zh: 使用前把它们取出来。逆时针拧松螺栓，把卡片里的螺栓取出来。

segments.text: Take out the welding head from X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder. Open the fastener. Remove the welding tip.
segments.zh: 从 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机上取下焊接头。打开卡扣。取下焊接头嘴。

segments.text: Align the protrusion on the cutting tip with the slot in the welding head.
segments.zh: 把切割头上的凸起对准焊接头上的槽。

segments.text: Insert the cutting tip. Close the fastener. Straighten the cable with the welding head
segments.zh: 插入切割头。扣上卡扣。牢牢握住焊接头，

segments.text: firmly held. Loop the welding head cable around the back of the carriage. Align the two grooves
segments.zh: 把线缆捋直。把焊接头线缆绕到滑车的后面。把焊接头侧面的

segments.text: on the side of the welding head with the two fixing pins of the carriage. Close the toggle latch.
segments.zh: 两个凹槽对准滑车的两个固定销。合上搭扣锁。

segments.text: Secure the three fixing rings on the cable to the corresponding slots. Snap the cable into the
segments.zh: 把线缆上的三个固定环固定到对应的槽中。把线缆卡入

segments.text: clamp. Ensure that the cable is fixed in place and doesn't touch the X-axis guide rail.
segments.zh: 线夹。确保线缆固定到位，并且不碰到 X 轴导轨。

segments.text: Install the cable fixing block. Before use, connect X-Tool Metal Fab CNC cutter to a power supply.
segments.zh: 安装线缆固定块。使用前，把 xTool MetalFab 数控切割机接上电源。

segments.text: Connect X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder to the power supply. Push the connector into the power
segments.zh: 把 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机接上电源。把接头推入

segments.text: port of X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder. Rotate to secure the power cable. Connect the other end of
segments.zh: xTool MetalFab 激光焊机的电源接口。转动以固定电源线。把电源线的另一端

segments.text: the power cable to a circuit that meets requirements. Wiring operations should be
segments.zh: 连接到符合要求的电路上。接线操作应由

segments.text: performed by a professional electrician. For more details, see X-Tool Metal Fab
segments.zh: 专业电工来完成。更多详情，请参阅 xTool MetalFab

segments.text: Laser Welder's Quick Start Guide. Ensure that the emergency stop buttons of the two machines
segments.zh: 激光焊机的快速入门指南。确保两台机器的急停按钮

segments.text: are released. Insert the key into its designated port of X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder. Shielding
segments.zh: 都已松开。把钥匙插入 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机的指定钥匙孔。保护

segments.text: gas inlet. Remove the dustproof cap. Insert one end of the tube into the shielding gas inlet.
segments.zh: 气进气口。取下防尘帽。把气管的一端插入保护气进气口。

segments.text: Connect the other end to the gas cylinder or air compressor and air dryer. Then open the valve
segments.zh: 把另一端连接到气瓶，或空压机和干燥机。然后按照

segments.text: according to the instructions for the cylinder or devices. Press the power switch. Press the power
segments.zh: 气瓶或设备的说明打开阀门。按下电源开关。按下电源

segments.text: switch. Download XCS. Download the latest version of XCS at X-Tool official website.
segments.zh: 开关。下载 XCS。在 xTool 官网下载最新版本的 XCS。

segments.text: Connect your X-Tool Metal Fab CNC cutter in XCS. Ready to go through the three calibration tasks.
segments.zh: 在 XCS 中连接你的 xTool MetalFab 数控切割机。准备完成三项校准任务。

segments.text: Calibration Task 1. Active vibration compensation. Click Start. Read the tips and click Start.
segments.zh: 校准任务 1：主动振动补偿。点击“开始”。阅读提示，然后点击“开始”。

segments.text: Read the tips in the dialog box. Press the start slash stop button on the machine.
segments.zh: 阅读对话框中的提示。按下机器上的“开始/停止”按钮。

segments.text: Click Done after the active vibration compensation concludes. Calibration Task 2. Laser focus
segments.zh: 主动振动补偿结束后点击“完成”。校准任务 2：激光焦点

segments.text: calibration. Click Start. Read the tips in the dialog box. Click Next. Follow the tips in XCS
segments.zh: 校准。点击“开始”。阅读对话框中的提示。点击“下一步”。按照 XCS 中的提示

segments.text: to adjust the cutting tip. Turn off the two machines. Take out the welding head.
segments.zh: 调整切割头。关闭两台机器。取出焊接头。

segments.text: Open the fastener. Pull out the cutting tip slowly. Use the 2.5 millimeter hex key included
segments.zh: 打开卡扣。慢慢拔出切割头。使用 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机包装中附带的

segments.text: in the package of heat X-Tool Metal Fab laser welder. Loosen the screw a bit.
segments.zh: 2.5 毫米内六角扳手。把螺丝稍微拧松一点。

segments.text: Slowly pull up the U-shaped component until its bottom reaches plus one. Tighten the screw.
segments.zh: 慢慢向上拉 U 形部件，直到它的底部到达 +1。拧紧螺丝。

segments.text: Pull the component back and forth to test if it's secured. Install the cutting tip back to
segments.zh: 前后拉动该部件，测试它是否已固定。把切割头装回

segments.text: the welding head. Close the fastener. Reinstall the welding head on the carriage and ensure that
segments.zh: 焊接头上。扣上卡扣。把焊接头重新装到滑车上，并确保

segments.text: the cable is properly placed. Click OK after the laser focus calibration concludes. Calibration
segments.zh: 线缆放置妥当。激光焦点校准结束后点击“确定”。校准

segments.text: Task 3. Red Spot Calibration. Click Start. Read the tips in the dialog box. Click Next.
segments.zh: 任务 3：红点校准。点击“开始”。阅读对话框中的提示。点击“下一步”。

segments.text: Follow the tips in the dialog box. Peel off the laser alignment sticker. Attach the sticker to
segments.zh: 按照对话框中的提示操作。撕下激光对准贴纸。把贴纸贴到

segments.text: the laser module and mind the orientation. Close the lid. Click Single Light Emission.
segments.zh: 激光模组上，注意方向。合上盖子。点击“单次出光”。

segments.text: After the operation is done, open the lid and take out the sticker.
segments.zh: 操作完成后，打开盖子，取出贴纸。

segments.text: Check if the spot falls in the center of the concentric circles.
segments.zh: 检查光斑是否落在同心圆的中心。

segments.text: You may use the clear tape instead following the same steps.
segments.zh: 你也可以用透明胶带代替，步骤相同。

segments.text: If the spot deviates from the center of the concentric circles as shown,
segments.zh: 如果光斑像图中这样偏离同心圆的中心，

segments.text: click Not Centered. Follow the tips to test the red spot position. Open the fastener.
segments.zh: 点击“未居中”。按照提示测试红点位置。打开卡扣。

segments.text: Turn the knob until it reaches negative 10, then close the fastener. Press the red stamp
segments.zh: 转动旋钮直到 -10，然后扣上卡扣。把红色印台

segments.text: pad against the cutting tip to leave colors on the tip. Then secure the laser alignment card
segments.zh: 按在切割头上，让切割头沾上颜色。然后把激光对准卡固定在

segments.text: right under the cutting tip. Click Confirm. The cutting tip is automatically lowered.
segments.zh: 切割头正下方。点击“确认”。切割头会自动下降。

segments.text: If it fails to touch the card, manually open the fastener and slightly rotate the knob
segments.zh: 如果它没碰到卡片，就手动打开卡扣，轻轻转动旋钮，

segments.text: until the red mark is left on the card. Then slowly lift the cutting tip and close the fastener.
segments.zh: 直到卡片上留下红色印记。然后慢慢抬起切割头，扣上卡扣。

segments.text: Click Next. Follow the tips to adjust the red spot position. To adjust the red spot left or right,
segments.zh: 点击“下一步”。按照提示调整红点位置。要左右调整红点，

segments.text: gently loosen or tighten the welding head screws with the hex key.
segments.zh: 用内六角扳手轻轻拧松或拧紧焊接头上的螺丝。

segments.text: To adjust the red spot forward or backward, click the corresponding button in XCS.
segments.zh: 要前后调整红点，点击 XCS 中对应的按钮。

segments.text: When the red spot is centered, click Complete the adjustment. Click Done. Click Done after
segments.zh: 红点居中后，点击“完成调整”。点击“完成”。红点校准结束后

segments.text: the red spot calibration concludes. Example project. Place a slat with its teeth facing up.
segments.zh: 点击“完成”。示例项目。放一根齿朝上的支撑条。

segments.text: Ensure that its ends fit snugly into two slots in the working area.
segments.zh: 确保它的两端紧密卡入工作区的两个槽中。

segments.text: Place slats at equal intervals as needed. Place a material on the slats. Rotate the
segments.zh: 根据需要等间距放置支撑条。把材料放在支撑条上。逆时针转动

segments.text: right fixture knob counterclockwise. Insert the right side of the material into the right fixture.
segments.zh: 右侧夹具旋钮。把材料的右侧插入右侧夹具。

segments.text: Rotate the knob clockwise to tighten the right fixture. Rotate the left fixture knob
segments.zh: 顺时针转动旋钮，拧紧右侧夹具。逆时针转动左侧夹具

segments.text: counterclockwise. Lift the linkage lever. Move the left fixture to the right to hold the material.
segments.zh: 旋钮。抬起联动杆。把左侧夹具向右移动以夹住材料。

segments.text: Rotate the knob clockwise to tighten the left fixture. Lower the linkage lever.
segments.zh: 顺时针转动旋钮，拧紧左侧夹具。放下联动杆。

segments.text: Open XCS and place the object on the material. Click the object. Click Unknown material at the
segments.zh: 打开 XCS，把对象放在材料上。点击该对象。点击右上角的

segments.text: upper right corner. Choose the corresponding material. Choose the corresponding tip.
segments.zh: “未知材料”。选择对应的材料。选择对应的切割头。

segments.text: Click Calibrate the capacitive sensor. Click Process. Before processing,
segments.zh: 点击“校准电容传感器”。点击“加工”。加工之前，

segments.text: check whether the requirements listed on the right panel are met. If yes, click Start.
segments.zh: 检查右侧面板上列出的要求是否都满足。如果满足，点击“开始”。

segments.text: Click Continue processing. Press the Start slash Stop button.
segments.zh: 点击“继续加工”。按下“开始/停止”按钮。

segments.text: Wear your heat-resistant gloves and pull out the base plate. Enjoy your first product.
segments.zh: 戴上耐热手套，拉出底盘。享受你的第一件作品吧。
